name: Debt-Accident Populism
description: Twin-Engine scenario (12% probability). Financial crisis triggers policy instability. Higher uncertainty suppresses investment (via G/C stability mechanism). Carbon pricing collapses. Fossil fuel subsidies persist. Slower transition. NOTE: interest is tax-financed by construction (a GDP claim, not new borrowing), so interest-capitalization debt spirals are structurally outside this model — debt stress appears as rising publicDebtService and the risk-premium channel. This scenario understates true spiral risk.
